lines: It's quiet. Ya. It's real quiet.
Yuna. I never said this to your father.
The fayth are waking up. That's all.
That's the end of my story.
I told it the way it happened, mostly.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: Hey. You're lookin' well for a dead guy.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: You're Sir Jecht. My father's guardian.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: For whatever a guy like me's word is worth.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: This thing's got me on a leash

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: There's another way. There's always another—

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: Don't you dare slow down now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: It hits all of us. Keep everyone up.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: I had nothin' to do with it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: You were always such a stiff.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: Tell Braska I did somethin' right eventually.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: I'll tell him myself. I promise.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: What is that noise? Make it stop—

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: It stopped meaning anything a long time ago.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Yuna. You don't have to be the one who—

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: I'll be here when they go.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: I know. I called you anyway.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Ixion. I never once had to ask twice.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Tell the boy I said thank you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Just for a second, look at me.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: That's it? That's what ate the world?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: It's quiet. Ya. It's real quiet.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Yuna. I never said this to your father.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: The fayth are waking up. That's all.
That's the end of my story.
I told it the way it happened, mostly.
I left in the part where she kept walking.
